name: Omni by xpander
description:
Omni is the built-in agent of the xpander.ai platform. Connect it and Claude gains a front door to your company's AI agents: agents that reach your internal systems, keep running after your conversation ends, and leave an audit trail your security team can stand behind.

What you can do from Claude:

* Ask Omni to build an agent. Describe the job in plain language and Omni wires the connectors, sets memory and schedules, tests it, and ships it.
* Delegate work to agents your teams already published - the security team's review agent, IT's access agent, finance's reconciliation check. Ask for it by name.
* Kick off long-running tasks. Agents execute on the platform, not in your session, so they keep working after you close the tab and report back when they finish.
* Reach real systems: 2,000+ tools and MCP connectors, plus your own private APIs generated from an OpenAPI spec.
* Check on your agents. Ask what ran, what it cost, what failed and why - then ask Omni to fix it.

xpander.ai is a vendor-neutral platform for building, deploying, and governing AI agents, founded by former AWS Principal Engineers and in production across financial services, government, technology, manufacturing, and retail. SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Omni scored 90.9% on the GAIA benchmark, with methodology and results public.

Getting started takes a sign-in at xpander.ai - no infrastructure to set up.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Omni by xpander to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Omni by xpander to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://omni.xpander.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Omni by xpander MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omni by xpander provides these MCP tools: ask_omni, ask_omni_async, get_capabilities, and get_omni_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Omni by xpander?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Omni by xpander in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Omni by xpander MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omni by xpander requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Omni by xpander is developed by xpander.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
